symbols.name: number of axes
symbols.meaning: The number of cyclic axes, a count.
symbols.quote: Let $d$ be the number of cyclic axes.

symbols.name: axis length
symbols.meaning: The number of positions along axis $i$, a count.
symbols.quote: Each $t_i$ is the number of positions along axis $i$, and the lengths $t_1,\dots,t_d$ are pairwise coprime.

symbols.name: total positions
symbols.meaning: The product of the axis lengths, which counts the total number of positions.
symbols.quote: Put $T = t_1 t_2 \cdots t_d$, which is the total number of positions.

symbols.name: Chinese-remainder map
symbols.meaning: The map that sends a position to its residues modulo each axis length.
symbols.quote: The map $\phi$ sends a position $n$, for $0 \le n < T$, to the tuple of its residues:

symbols.name: position
symbols.meaning: A position in the cyclic coefficient list, an index from $0$ to $T-1$.
symbols.quote: The map $\phi$ sends a position $n$, for $0 \le n < T$, to the tuple of its residues:

symbols.name: first position
symbols.meaning: One of two positions whose product term is being tracked.
symbols.quote: So a product term at positions $u$ and $v$ lands, after relabeling, at the box point $\phi(u)+\phi(v)$, with each coordinate reduced modulo its axis length.

symbols.name: second position
symbols.meaning: The other of the two positions whose product term is being tracked.
symbols.quote: So a product term at positions $u$ and $v$ lands, after relabeling, at the box point $\phi(u)+\phi(v)$, with each coordinate reduced modulo its axis length.

symbols.name: axis index
symbols.meaning: An index labelling one of the $d$ axes.
symbols.quote: The Chinese remainder theorem says $\phi$ is a bijection, and it respects sums: for each axis $r$, the $r$th coordinate of a sum of two positions is the sum of their $r$th coordinates, reduced modulo $t_r$.

relations.quote: The map is applied to the coefficient list of [Radix-digit convolution](radix-digit-convolution.md).
